_comment: Hand-written semantics for talents the DB2 data can't express (server-scripted dummy auras, conditional effects). Keys: talent name or spell ID. mods replace the generated entry for the same spell; dropMods removes generated links by spell name.

Deep Wounds.note: Proc chain: any melee crit → Deep Wound bleed. Stronger with Cruelty, Impale and Improved Overpower, which add crits or crit damage.

Flurry.note: Proc chain: crit → Flurry → more swings → more Unbridled Wrath Rage and more chances to crit again.

Unbridled Wrath.note: Resource loop: every weapon hit can add Rage, so fast or dual-wield weapons get more out of it than a slow two-hander.

Enrage.note: Proc chain: getting hit → Enrage → more Physical damage for 12 sec. Best when tanking or soloing, rare in a raid.

mods.fx: hits cleave to a second target
hits cleave to a second target
hits cleave to a second target
swings cleave to a second target

Sweeping Strikes.note: Doubles single-target hits for the next 5 attacks when two enemies are close.

Weaponmaster.note: Axe/Polearm: more crit (feeds Deep Wounds and Flurry). Mace/Staff: ignores armor. Sword: extra attacks.

Dual Wield Specialization.note: Resource loop: off-hand swings hit harder and give more Rage.

Anger Management.note: Resource loop: a steady Rage trickle feeds every spender, most noticeable when Rage is short (low gear, missing hits).

Improved Tactical Mastery.note: Resource loop: stance-dance into Overpower (Battle) or Whirlwind (Berserker) without throwing away the Rage you need for your main attack.

Cruelty.note: More crits feed Deep Wounds, Flurry and Impale.

mods.fx: shorter cooldown, more damage to the closest enemy

Shield Specialization.note: Resource loop: blocks generate Rage and enable Revenge.

Master of Defense.note: Resource loop: dodges and parries generate Rage while a shield is equipped.

Blood Craze.note: Proc: being crit or hit hard → regenerate health. Defensive, mostly for soloing.

Bloodthrill.note: Proc chain: keep Rend up → main-hand hits can enable Overpower → more Overpower crits (Improved Overpower, Deep Wounds).
